_comment: Screenshot manifest for `node ~/alvaro/scripts/nexo-shots.mjs .`. Underscore-prefixed keys are comments (JSON has none) — the script ignores them.
_rules: LOCAL instance only, seeded with DemoSeeder (design.md, Family): `docker compose up -d` then `artisan migrate:fresh --seed --seeder=DemoSeeder`. Never production — these figures are the landing's proof, and the proof cannot be somebody's real page.
_trap: Run `artisan cache:clear` after any `npm run build` and before capturing. Public pages are cached rendered (Page::flushCache), asset URLs and all, so a cached page keeps pointing at the previous build's hashed CSS — which no longer exists. The figure then comes out unstyled, and it looks like a broken product rather than a stale cache.
_login: The DemoSeeder user. The script signs in through the real form, so nothing capture-only has to exist in the app.
